rows.label: tlk47100161_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I've been practicing salvaging so I
can be like Rex-nii-chan, but I just
can't manage to dive...

rows.label: tlk47100161_02_msg0002
rows.name:
When I go deep, my ears feel all
fuzzy and I start feeling sick...

rows.label: tlk47100161_02_msg0003
rows.name:
But I'm really good at filling
cylinders with gas! I can fill them
exactly to the top!

rows.label: tlk47100161_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Someone even said I was better than
old man Trope at the cylinder shop!
Think I might help out there sometime!
